notes: The invoice prints a 10% festive discount (-8,680.00) between the items and the subtotal. It is recorded in the discount field as a POSITIVE 8,680.00, and the subtotal is the discounted figure printed on the invoice, so line items (86,800.00) minus discount equals the subtotal (78,120.00). The discount must NOT appear as a line item. A client may instead want it captured as a negative line item, in which case the line_items count would be 4 rather than 3.
